A unique railway bunkhouse in the Highlands.
Learn More
The West Highland Way Sleeper is a bunkhouse hostel on the Bridge of Orchy Station platform.
Come and stay at the most unique accommodation on the West Highland Way.
Ready to explore the West Highland Way?
We are now taking bookings for the 2024 season.
Book Now
Our bunkhouse has some of the most competitive prices on the West Highland Way.
We currently have a ten person bunk room, or a private room for four with 4 bunks and en-suite bathroom facilities, which can be booked in its entirety (sorry not for single occupancy though).

About West Highland Way Sleeper
0
“What makes the West Highland Sleeper a MUST stay is Helen, it's owner! She is the heartbeat of one of the most unique places I have stayed and as a travel professional, I have stayed at thousands of places. From the old world charm of staying literally in a historic train depot to the love that Helen gives to each and every person that comes, this is a highlight to any stay in Scotland.”
Google Review Oct '21
About us.
Getting Here.
As well as being a working train station, we are directly along the famous West Highland Way trail. We are also accessible by car, just off the A82.
www.thetrainline.com/stations/bridge-of-orchy
Facilities.
The main bunkroom has an adjoining shower and toilet block, and towel rental is available upon request. We also have a 4 bed en-suite bunkroom that can be booked out in it's entirety.
Laundry facilities at the green welly in tyndrum . Coin operated Washing machines and dryers on the car park.
There is a defibrillator located on site
Food.
Currently food is available on request. We can cater for various dietary needs. Please enquire upon booking.
Payments.
Deposit due upon booking, remaining balance 4 weeks prior to arrival. We take all major credit/debit cards, and will send a secure WorldPay link for payment.
Booking.
Call or email to enquire about availability. We will be as flexible as possible.
Reviews.
Enjoyed your stay with us? Please leave us a tripadvisor or google review to help build our profile.
